  relation "be a citizen of"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Netherlands"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "live in"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Timișoara"

  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "an EU registration certificate"

  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "own"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a flat in Utrecht"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "generate rental income from"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a flat in Utrecht"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "have to pay CASS in Romania on"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "rental income from a flat in Utrecht"
    polarity affirmed
  end
